title: Closing a Northloop Payments Account
content:
**Terms of closure.** Closing the payments account is the seller's own decision and is confirmed by the seller. After the request the whole balance, reserves included, is held for the closure final hold days counted from the request date; refunds, claims and chargebacks arriving in that period are still debited. At the end of the hold all reserves are released and the entire balance is paid out, or, if negative, collected from the card on file; the account closes once the balance is zero.

## Course of a closure

| Stage | Account state | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Seller's request (from active or on hold) | closing | the whole balance, reserves included, is held for the closure final hold days counted from the request date |
| During the final hold | closing | refunds, claims and chargebacks arriving are still debited |
| End of the final hold | closing | all reserves are released; the entire balance is paid out, or, if negative, collected from the card on file |
| Balance at zero | closed | the account closes |

*Hypothetical reading.* On Payments Enterprise, whose closure final hold is 60 days, a request made on day R holds the balance for 60 calendar days counted from day R; on Payments Weekly the same request holds it for 90.
